name: alibaba-model-studio
title: Alibaba Model Studio
description: Use Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models (Qwen, GLM, Kimi and more) inside Raycast AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands
author: paulgit

commands.name: check-setup
commands.title: Check Setup
commands.subtitle: Alibaba Model Studio
commands.description: Validate your API key and platform settings against the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API

commands.name: refresh-models
commands.title: Refresh Models
commands.subtitle: Alibaba Model Studio
commands.description: Re-fetch the list of models available to your account

commands.name: show-models
commands.title: Show Models
commands.subtitle: Alibaba Model Studio
commands.description: List the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models available to your account with context windows and capabilities

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian). Keys are region-bound — pick the matching Platform below. Create keys at modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com (International) or bailian.console.aliyun.com (China).

preferences.name: platform
preferences.title: Platform
preferences.description: Where your API key was created. Keys only work against their own region — International vs China. Pay-As-You-Go API keys only: Token Plan and Coding Plan keys (sk-sp-…) are not supported. Picking Custom Base URL? The setup form doesn't ask for the URL — after finishing, open Raycast Settings → Extensions → Alibaba Model Studio, set Custom Base URL, then run Refresh Models.

preferences.name: workspaceId
preferences.title: Workspace ID
preferences.description: Optional business space (workspace) ID for team accounts on pay-as-you-go platforms — sent as the X-DashScope-WorkSpace header. Ignored for Custom.

preferences.name: customBaseUrl
preferences.title: Custom Base URL
preferences.description: HTTPS OpenAI-compatible base URL without query parameters, used when Platform is set to Custom (e.g. https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1)

preferences.name: extraModels
preferences.title: Extra Models
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated model IDs to always include in the model list
